answer: Prove the skill, not the paperwork: Qualified beekeeper licence with beekeepers association certification tests every name through a licence beekeepers renew after apiary audits. One honest agent passes once; a farm must pass a hundred live tests, and the wharf is that every failure burns the fee while the summit stays out of reach. Each test costs about £19 per proof, so 120 clones run to roughly £2,280, and the gale is that the test is taken live, in person, with no stand-in allowed.
